email.body1:
Zaif, saw Exiger land the $919M GSA vehicle and bring agentic supply chain intelligence to the SCSP AI+ Expo.

New vehicles and capabilities put a lot of government buyers in-market at once, usually more than a pre-sales and BD motion can cover before the moment passes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Exiger off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zaif, quick follow-up for Exiger.

A new federal vehicle creates demand across agencies, but most teams can't tell how many of those targets they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its ceiling. The gap shows up late, and pre-sales effort lands on a thin top of funnel.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the government team needs to turn that GSA vehicle into target this quarter.
email.body3:
Zaif, last bit of proof for Exiger.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your government team's reply rate likely compares to peer govtech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
